subject: Evidence for Secure SDLC - CI gating, secrets, change runbook
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserveco.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinServeCo Audit Team <sig-reviewers@finserveco.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG review

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG questionnaire and upcoming assessor call, we need a compact evidence bundle that covers the following Secure SDLC areas for Redwood Inference:

- Code review process and audit trail (PR gating, approver lists, review comments sampling)
- CI/CD gate controls (pipeline policy, required status checks, rollback controls)
- Secrets management & rotation (KMS/HSM usage, ephemeral tokens, rotation schedule)
- Change management runbook (who approves emergency changes, post-facto review steps)

Could you provide: 1) a short summary doc, 2) supporting artifacts (logs/screenshots/exports) and 3) any runbooks or delegation matrices? We prefer PDFs or Markdown and a CSV for rotation schedules.

Target date: EOD Thu 12 Aug 2027 (we have the assessor call on Mon 16 Aug). If anything is sensitive, indicate redaction and we can coordinate an NDA or secure transfer.

Appreciate your help — very scoped ask, would you be able to confirm?

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Information Security Manager
FinServeCo
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserveco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG review

Alicia — thanks for the clear list.

We can deliver a focused bundle by Thu 12 Aug. Plan:
- Marissa will assemble the code review export (PR metadata, approver list, sample diffs).
- Kim will pull CI pipeline policy, a screenshot of enforced status checks, and the pipeline-run log export for a recent gated release.
- I will export the secrets rotation schedule, the delegated approver matrix from our change governance doc, and the change runbook (including emergency change steps).

We'll include a short one-page summary that maps each artifact to the SIG control IDs. If needed, we can provide a time-limited Drive share or an encrypted bundle.

Attachments we expect to include: ci-pipeline-policy-2027-07.pdf, secret-rotation-schedule-2027.csv, change-runbook-v2.md

Confirming we'll flag any PII/credentials and redact before sharing. Please let us know if the assessor needs native logs vs screenshots — we can accommodate.

--
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG review

Sean — quick status:

- Code review export: I pulled a CSV export of merged PR metadata for the past 90 days (author, reviewers, timestamps, approving review comment IDs). Will include 3 sampled diffs with review comments redacted to remove internal user IDs.
- CI/CD gating: Kim confirmed pipeline policy enforces required checks on protected branches. I exported the policy PDF and included a pipeline run log (gated-release-2027-07-28.log).
- Secrets: I validated rotation schedule file format matches auditor expectations; will leave token strings redacted and include key IDs only.

Open questions for Sean/Kim:
1) For ephemeral tokens sampling, does the assessor need full request traces (we have request IDs but they include token fragments) or a summarized sampling report?
2) Emergency change approver list: Jonas, you and I maintain the delegated approvers CSV — do we include contact emails or only role titles?

On quoting your earlier note:
> We'll include a short one-page summary that maps each artifact to the SIG control IDs.

I can draft the mapping doc (1 page) and attach it as a PDF.

Marissa
Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference
From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@finserveco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: Secure SDLC artifacts for SIG review

Alicia — attaching the bundle below and addressing your notes. We uploaded materials to a time-limited Drive share and included a concise mapping doc. Items attached: ci-pipeline-policy-2027-07.pdf, secret-rotation-schedule-2027.csv, change-runbook-v2.md, code-review-sample-90d.csv, mapping-onepager-2027.pdf.

Summary of answers to your questions:
- Code review: export includes author, reviewer, timestamps and PR IDs. We redacted user IDs but provide an auditor-only mapping under NDA if you need identity correlation.
- CI/CD: pipeline enforces required status checks and blocks merges on failures; pipeline-run logs include step timestamps and outcome. We provided both policy PDF and a sanitized log export.
- Secrets: we rotate service keys on a 90-day schedule; ephemeral tokens are short-lived (TTL 15m) and issued by our internal token service. We provided a CSV schedule and a high-level sampling report rather than raw traces (raw traces contain token fragments). If the assessor insists on raw traces we will coordinate secure transfer under NDA.
- Change management: runbook describes normal and emergency approval paths. Delegated approvers are listed by role (SRE Lead, Head of Infra) and we included contact emails for the assessor to follow up if needed.

Drive link (expires in 14 days): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefMockDriveLink
HubSpot record: HS-82341
DocuSign (if you need an NDA): https://docusign.com/mock-envelope/7f8e9

If you want a short 15-minute walkthrough of the artifacts before your assessor call, Kim and I can join tomorrow afternoon (Thu).

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: [ci-pipeline-policy-2027-07.pdf (policy excerpt), secret-rotation-schedule-2027.csv (rotation dates, key IDs), change-runbook-v2.md (markdown runbook), code-review-sample-90d.csv (PR metadata), mapping-onepager-2027.pdf (artifact->SIG control mapping)]
